briefing.text: On News (Nov 17), Information Technology stayed #1 with buzz 86.9 (+0.9 on the day, -1.5 over the week), mentions +17% and sentiment -0.03, led by NVDA, MSFT, AMD, INTC and MU. Communication Services (+1.2 buzz, mentions +27%, GOOGL, META) and Materials (+1.3, NEM, AEM) rose, while Real Estate (-2.2, mentions -20%) and Energy (-0.7, 7d -2.1, CVX, XOM) fell. On X, IT was again #1 at 93.5 (+0.2, mentions +18%, NVDA, MU, AMD), and Consumer Staples slipped (-0.4, mentions -16%, HIMS, WMT, COST). On Reddit, IT led at 94.8 (+0.6, mentions +48%, NVDA, ANT, AAPL), Health Care jumped from #7 to #4 (+4.6 buzz, mentions +300%, SLS, MRNA, LLY, NVO) and Financial Services fell (-5.8, mentions -48%, mostly money-market and index funds). Small-cap labelled sectors with few tickers (e.g. Basic Materials on X, RML) show big percentage moves from tiny bases.

DIS #1: Disney beat earnings and Bank of America lifted its target to $135, though one outlet says the stock fell 1.5% despite 16% revenue growth; it explains the rank.
TTWO #2: GTA VI is out and reportedly scored 99 on Metacritic, with Wells Fargo seeing 65M copies by March; it explains the rank.
NVDA #3: Coverage of the post-earnings market drop and a reported Jensen Huang resignation as chair/CEO talk (Polymarket CEO markets are heavily traded); it explains the rank.
WWD #4: Reported adjusted EPS $2.83, beating by $0.31, and revenue $1.2B beat by $60M; it explains the rank.
PANW #5: Adjusted EPS $1.05 beat by $0.08 and revenue $3.45B beat by $140M, stock +9.9% in 24h; it explains the rank.
TGT #6: Q3 call highlights cite a comparable sales jump; news is mostly positive (31 of 55); it explains the rank.
WDAY #7: Workday agreed to buy Honeydew; the rank looks driven by a software sell-off (WDAY -9.6% over 5 days) more than by the deal.
INTU #9: Headlines focus on Salesforce's worst day since 2024 on AI-agent fears and Intuit's earnings due Thursday; negative news fits the rank.

DIS ranks #1 (score 0.956) on attention at 1.58x normal and X attention 1.55x, plus a 3.2-sigma price move (+4.6% in 24h) and volume 1.17x normal. TTWO is #2 (0.953, up from #5) with volume 2.5x normal and a 1.9-sigma move (+6.2%) around the GTA VI launch, with attention near normal (0.93x). NVDA is #3 (0.900, up from #10): attention 0.90x, volume 1.67x normal and a KPI-market-resolves catalyst, with large Reddit, X and news mention counts, though price fell 2.9% in 24h. Momentum and catalyst inputs, not open interest, carry these ranks.

notes: Ranks are by the scoring of record (pick_rank, w2). Prices and moves as of the last pull of the day. Facts from public data; not investment advice.
